localPolicy.note: The local template accepts Firebase Auth emulator email/password only.

providers.label: Email + password
providers.localNote: Primary day-one path through the Firebase Auth emulator.
providers.productionNote: Enable Email/Password in Firebase Authentication before production use.

providers.label: Google account
providers.localNote: OAuth browser consent is intentionally disabled in the local emulator lane.
providers.productionNote: Enable Google and configure authorized domains in Firebase Authentication.

providers.label: Email link / code
providers.localNote: Passwordless email requires a configured sender and authorized domain.
providers.productionNote: Use Firebase email-link auth; an email OTP service is a separate backend module.

providers.label: Auth code / custom token
providers.localNote: Only a trusted local backend or emulator seed may mint a custom token.
providers.productionNote: Issue short-lived Firebase custom tokens from a trusted server; never accept arbitrary browser tokens.

providers.label: SSO / OIDC / SAML
providers.localNote: Provider-specific tenant metadata and redirect domains are required.
providers.productionNote: Configure an approved Firebase OIDC/SAML provider and tenant policy before enabling.
